basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Varanasi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 8 Project Assistant, JRF and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Project Attendant, Project Assistant, Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Research Associate-I, and Senior Project Scientist (Professional Grade-I)

age_limit.details: The upper age limits vary by post as specified in the official notification.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project attendant: Graduate Degree in Sciences with experience in water quality sampling and testing including the application of NbS system (1 in no.) OR Graduate Degree in Fine Arts/Design/Architecture with proficiency in office software, such as Microsoft Word, Excel, CAD/Photoshop/InDesign/CorelDraw/Illustrator etc. (1 in no.). | project assistant: Graduation in Science or Engineering fields OR 3 years Diploma in Engg. & Technology with knowledge related to water quality sampling and testing including the application of NbS system. | junior research fellow (jrf): Master’s Degree in Science and Engg in the field of (Hydraulics /River Engineering /Water Resources /Geoinformatics with GATE /NET or any equivalent national level examinations qualified). | research associate-i: Ph.D. or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research and teaching experience after M.Sc./M.Tech. with at least 1 paper in SCI Journal. Essential Qualifications and Specialization: Related to design and implementation of Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for treating waste water AND Hydrological/Hydrogeological Modelling. | senior project scientist (professional grade-i): Ph.D. in Environment Science, Water Resources or any relevant discipline and having 6-8 years of research or teaching experience.

salary_details.details: HRA will be given as per the Government norms.

followed by a Test and/or Interview for shortlisted candidates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Application Form provided in Annexure-I of the official notification.
Prepare a single PDF file attaching all requisite degrees and certificates.
Access the Google Form link provided in the official notification.
Upload the completed application PDF and required documents to the Google Form.
Submit the form on or before 29.10.2026.
important_instructions: The initial appointment shall be valid until August 2027 and is co-terminus with the project duration. SLCR reserves the right to set benchmarks and call only eligible candidates for Test and/or Interview. The Selection Committee reserves the right not to fill any of the posts advertised without assigning reasons. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated to appear in the interview through email ONLY. Selected candidates are expected to join within a month. The position is purely contractual, with no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Varanasi Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies are available under the Secretariat for SLCR at IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

rows.qualification_required: Graduate Degree in Sciences with experience in water quality sampling and testing including the application of NbS system (1 in no.) OR Graduate Degree in Fine Arts/Design/Architecture with proficiency in office software, such as Microsoft Word, Excel, CAD/Photoshop/InDesign/CorelDraw/Illustrator etc. (1 in no.).
Graduation in Science or Engineering fields OR 3 years Diploma in Engg. & Technology with knowledge related to water quality sampling and testing including the application of NbS system.
Master’s Degree in Science and Engg in the field of (Hydraulics /River Engineering /Water Resources /Geoinformatics with GATE /NET or any equivalent national level examinations qualified).

Ph.D. or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research and teaching experience after M.Sc./M.Tech. with at least 1 paper in SCI Journal. Essential Qualifications and Specialization: Related to design and implementation of Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for treating waste water AND Hydrological/Hydrogeological Modelling.
Ph.D. in Environment Science, Water Resources or any relevant discipline and having 6-8 years of research or teaching experience.

The position is purely contractual, with no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT (BHU) Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by the Secretariat for Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers (SLCR) at IIT (BHU) Varanasi under the National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) for various project positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available across different posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via the Google form is 29.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date for applications?
Q5. What are the posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts include Project Attendant, Project Assistant, Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Research Associate-I, and Senior Project Scientist (Professional Grade-I).

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is 30 years.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the prescribed application form, prepare a single PDF file with all certificates, and submit it through the official Google form link.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent positions?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely contractual in nature and co-terminus with the project duration.
